name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-float-array-modification-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString, excluding cloneReadOnly.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; value:cloneReadOnly is absent.
reason: The expected panic on modifying b[1] depends on creating a frozen float array using a.cloneReadOnly(). That essential langlib operation is outside both the supported library-method list and the method-syntax list, so the asserted frozen-array mutation behavior is outside this subset.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts failure of indexed mutation after cloning to readonly; ordinary list construction and assignment support does not establish support for that prerequisite operation.
